high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from "nofilmschool.com," as indicated by the URL at the top. The content discusses Senator Albert Fall, who was accused of accepting bribes from oil companies in exchange for drainage rights. The text explains that during a 1920s U.S. Senate hearing, Senator Fall used a metaphor to explain his position on drainage rights. The metaphor he used is: "If you have a milkshake and I have a milkshake, and my straw reaches across the room, I can drink your milkshake." This statement is attributed to Anderson, who is likely a character or figure
